context: A lecture on how cells are built
purpose: Explain cell biology; teach 物質/形成/プロセス/手法/用い/相互/生命/破壊

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 細胞は、たんぱく質という物質でできています。
lines.en: Cells are made of a substance called protein.
lines.style: lecturer stating the fundamentals, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: その形成には、どれくらい時間がかかるんですか？
lines.en: How long does that formation take?
lines.style: engaged student probing the timescale, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 一瞬です。複雑なプロセスが体内で進みます。
lines.en: An instant. A complex process runs inside the body.
lines.style: lecturer conveying the marvel, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 観察にはどんな手法を使うんですか？
lines.en: What method do you use to observe it?
lines.style: student asking about technique, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 特殊な顕微鏡を用います。
lines.style: lecturer answering concisely, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 細胞同士も相互に信号を送り合うんですね。
lines.en: Cells send signals to each other mutually too.
lines.style: student grasping the interplay, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、その仕組みが生命を支えています。
lines.style: lecturer tying it to the bigger picture

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病気は、その破壊から始まるんですね。
lines.en: Disease begins with the destruction of that, huh.
lines.style: student reaching a darker realization, tone holding steady through the whole line
